current_entry.description: Gantt charts for real project tracking: plan vs actual bars, automatic highlighting of delays, early finishes and pauses, vacation and day-off columns, per-day comments, sticky headers. Configured with a simple YAML code block. - This plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
